app.serviceGuardMessage:
Backend servingDir is not the mobile device/preview standard path /storage/emulated/0. Capacitor preview requires ApplyMobileOverlay to be active. Correct startup steps:

1. Start with mobile overlay (recommended):
make dev-mobile

2. Or manual equivalent:
ENCV_MOBILE=1 ENCV_DEV_PREVIEW=1 go run ./cmd/encv start

Note: Do NOT use ENCV_CONFIG_PATH, do NOT modify config.user.json, do NOT use npx cap serve.
